answer: Proof, not promises: Mender silk skirt warrant sewn into the tailor's shop asks for each silk skirt is a year of sewing logs in the cloth ledger, and no farm can supply it honestly. Stake 6 times the reward and the farm must park 22101 POA to chase 139 seats it will likely never win. One atlas proves a maker, one quill proves a payment, one nectar proves a wait — and a wait is the one thing a printer cannot paint. Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is read aloud against an open register. The farm tried to buy the epoch and found the epoch is not for sale.
